description_en: Queries the information about images in a region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下一个或多个镜像信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-images --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-ids fe9c66133a9d4688872869726b520000_,_794c230fd3e64ea19f83f4d7a0ad0000 --image-type system --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImages

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the images. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the images. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The image IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 50 image IDs. Format: `["xxx", "yyy", … "zzz"]`. Separate multiple image IDs with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh: 镜像ID。取值可以由一个或多个镜像ID组成一个JSON数组。格式为`["xxx", "yyy", … "zzz"]`。支持最多50个ID，用半角逗号字符隔开。
parameters.help_en: The image IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 50 image IDs. Format: `["xxx", "yyy", … "zzz"]`. Separate multiple image IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。取值可以由一个或多个镜像ID组成一个JSON数组。格式为`["xxx", "yyy", … "zzz"]`。支持最多50个ID，用半角逗号字符隔开
parameters.name: image_ids

parameters.description_en:
The type of the images. Valid values:

- system: OS images

- app: application images

- custom: custom images
parameters.description_zh:
镜像类型。取值范围：

- system：系统镜像
- app：应用镜像
- custom：自定义镜像
